title: Vehicle catalog
description: Brands, models and types from the monthly TSB kasko value list, with kasko values per model year.

brands.active_hint: Inactive brands are hidden from organization vehicle forms.
models.create_description: Manual models can be assigned to types and used in prefix rules.
models.rename_description: Brand: {{brand}}. A renamed model is marked manual.
models.merge_description: The {{count}} types and rules of {{name}} move to the selected model, then {{name}} is deleted.
types.save_rule_hint: Types of this brand whose name starts with the prefix get this model, now and in future imports.

types.not_found: This type could not be loaded.

imports.upload_description: The .xlsx file is stored privately and analysed first; nothing changes until you apply it.
imports.period_hint: Leave empty to read it from cell A1 (e.g. "Ekim 2026").
imports.empty_description: Upload the monthly TSB kasko list to start.
imports.detail_description: Dry-run summary of the list; apply it to update the catalog.
imports.not_found: This import could not be loaded.

imports.running_processing: Reading the list and computing the changes…
imports.running_applying: Applying the changes to the catalog…
imports.ready_description: Review the counts and samples below, then apply the list.
imports.applied_description: The numbers below are what the apply changed in the catalog. Applying the same list again changes nothing.

brands.view_tsb_hint: Each brand code of the TSB list is one row; imports match on these codes.
brands.view_display_hint: The brands users see. TSB codes of one make (e.g. FIAT and TOFAS-FIAT) are merged into one brand here.
brands.display_brand_hint: The display brand this TSB brand belongs to. To give it its own display brand, unmerge it in the Display brands view.
display_brands.edit_description: TSB brands: {{names}}. A rename also applies to these TSB brands.
display_brands.active_hint: Inactive display brands are hidden from organization vehicle forms.
display_brands.merge_description: The TSB brands of {{name}} ({{names}}) move to the selected display brand.
display_brands.merge_confirm_description: {{names}} → {{into}}. The display brand {{from}} and its logo are deleted; same-name models are shown to organizations as one model.
display_brands.unmerge_description: The selected TSB brand leaves {{name}} and moves to a new display brand.
display_brands.unmerge_name_hint: Left empty, it is made from the TSB name (e.g. Tofas-Fiat).
display_brands.unmerge_default_name: name made from the TSB name
display_brands.unmerge_confirm_descripti: {{tsb}} leaves {{from}} and moves to the display brand “{{name}}”.
display_brands.logo_description: The {{name}} logo is shown in organization vehicle forms. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG.
models.merge_hint: Models of the other TSB brands of the same display brand can be picked too; the model then takes the target's name and both are shown as one model.
models.grouped_hint: The same name exists under {{count}} TSB brands; organizations see one model.
models.rules_description: A “type name starts with the model name” rule is saved for the {{count}} selected models (e.g. {{names}}); types without a model or with an automatic one follow it now, and so do later imports.
queue.title: {{count}} types without a model
queue.keyboard_hint: Tab to the model field, press Enter to open it, type to search, pick with ↑/↓ and Enter. The assigned type leaves the queue and focus moves to the next one.
queue.create_description: The model is created and assigned to “{{name}}”.
queue.empty_description: Every active type has a model.
types.no_values_hint: Values from a later import appear here.
